# Worldtree audio credits

Every sound in this folder is cut from a field or foley recording that its author released into the public domain.
No attribution is required for any of them; the authors are credited here with thanks.
`tools/worldtree-audio.json` holds the exact excerpt and processing of each file, and `tools/place-audio.py --set worldtree` rebuilds them.

## Files

- `canopy.mp3` is cut from "wind-thru-trees.AIF" by alienistcog, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/alienistcog/sounds/123911/.
- `gust.mp3` is cut from "Forest, close up of trees rustling in the wind.wav" by Anya_Media, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/Anya_Media/sounds/523389/.
